mount_identity_rule_frozen: the deeper mount's claim population - every file under results/product/gate_packet/ plus state/product.json - must be byte-identical to the accepted mount's, path-by-path, with both file lists and both digests published. The ONLY intended difference is the git object store depth (and therefore the resolvability of cc719eebf). The deeper mount's HEAD must equal the accepted mount's HEAD (c1a6547e...). Any claim-population byte difference is ENVIRONMENT_ERROR (exit 2), never a scored-claim movement.
non_vacuity_control_frozen: a synthetic control mount is built by copying the deeper mount's git history and replacing state/product.json with a version carrying one extra planted scored row (decision_id=SYNTHETIC_PLANTED_ROW_39529073155, clearly marked synthetic); the frozen instrument must return composite TRIGGER_FIRES__SCORED_CLAIM_MOVED__RE_SCORE_JUSTIFIED on it. If the control does NOT flip, the adjudication is NON_VACUOUS (exit 1) and no composite is published as a measurement. Synthetic artifacts are stored under the run's control/ subdirectory with explicit synthetic markers and are never mixed with the real adjudication record.
success_rule_frozen: exit 0 with a decided composite (H_A or H_B) AND the trigger verdict reproducing AND mount-identity proven AND the planted control flipping; exit 1 on NON_VACUOUS (control undetected) or on any check weakening; exit 2 on ENVIRONMENT_ERROR (unfetchable baseline object, missing mount, byte-identity failure, frozen-instrument hash mismatch). The adjudication publishes BOTH legs side by side: the frozen trigger's set relation (already published by 39520368732 and re-published here on the identical population) and the scored-claim movement leg (the new measurement).
